title: Kafka's Trial as a description of a spectral angelic bureaucracy
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Kafka's Trial as a description of a spectral angelic bureaucracy, about early 20th century at Prague, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I wrote an essay um interpreting Kafka's trial uh that's in my anthology lovers of Sophia

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani tells podcast host Jesse Michels about an essay he wrote, collected in his book Lovers of Sophia, that reads The Trial, a novel by the Prague writer Franz Kafka, together with Kafka's private notebooks. Jorjani's reading is that the faceless court in the novel describes a ghostly bureaucracy of angels, which would mean Kafka was writing about real unseen powers, not only fiction.
